title: Venus de Milo
subtitle: Aphrodite of Melos
assetDescription: Optimized scan of the SMK plaster cast after the ancient marble Venus de Milo. This is a museum cast scan, not a scan of the Louvre marble original.
museum: SMK — National Gallery of Denmark, Royal Cast Collection
licenseEvidence: The downloaded official SMK KAS434 and KAS434/1 records both declare public_domain true and Public Domain Mark 1.0. The requested Sketchfab listing is independently identified as CC0 by the IIIF fixture repository; the runtime derivative uses the official SMK STL.
credit: Venus de Milo, plaster cast, SMK — National Gallery of Denmark. Public domain. Web optimization for IOM — Gallery of Light.

history.subject: Aphrodite, the Greek goddess also known as Venus in Roman tradition
history.discovery: Discovered on Melos (Milos) in 1820; entered the Louvre in 1821.
history.description: The turn of the torso and the falling drapery create a balance of movement and stillness. Its surviving form is incomplete; no speculative arms have been added to this scan.

geometry.pivot: Bottom center of the X/Z bounding box
geometry.heightBasis: 213.5 cm gross height of the SMK standing plaster cast KAS434/1. Uniform scaling preserves the scan proportions; the Louvre original is separately catalogued as 204 cm.
geometry.changes: Uniform metric scaling; centered floor pivot; silhouette-preserving reduction; original surface-normal transfer; removal of two tiny isolated collapsed faces; Draco compression. No reconstruction or intentional pose changes.

roundTripDeviation.method: Bidirectional nearest-surface samples between the original scan and the Blender-reimported Draco GLB; sampled measure, not an exhaustive Hausdorff bound.
